description: Punto Geodésico. Bogotá D.C is a dataset listed in City of Bogotá open data portal (Datos Abiertos Bogotá), an open data portal, published or maintained by Unidad Administrativa Especial de Catastro Distrital - UAECD. Punto materializado cuyas coordenadas fueron obtenidas por métodos geodésicos y están ligados al sistema de referencia MAGNA-SIRGAS. Se incluyen los puntos administrados por la EAAB-ESP y el Servicio Geológico Colombiano. Coverage: Bogotá. The portal files it under the publisher Unidad Administrativa Especial de Catastro Distrital - UAECD. Its tags are Punto Geodésico, Punto de control, Topografía. It offers 8 resource(s) in DXF, ESRI REST, GEOJSON, GPKG, KMZ. The portal shows 2023-09-27 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support positioning and survey control studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bogota-portal.
